name: v1.39.7 - RAFT boot-time race, async replication and batch delete Fixes
body:
## Breaking Changes 
*none*

## New Features
*none*

## Fixes
* async replication: retry a panicking hashtree init attempt and gate hashbeat on readiness by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13202
* fix(reindex): index writes that land in a semantic migration's swap window by @etiennedi in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13001
* backport: try to safe cast array values  by @DanielJanicek in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13223
* fix(raft): guard the bootstrap candidates map against concurrent notifies by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12533
* fix: publish the raft node atomically to close a boot-time data race by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/12623
* fix(raft): load the atomic raft node at the FSM barrier call sites by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13225
* fix(stream): soft memory backpressure for `BatchStream` by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13028
* test(grpc): fix TestBatchObjectsSemaphore deadlock by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13228
* backport: drop the experimental search flag, harden the family for default-on (#13067) by @g-despot in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13233
* Speed up the wait-group linter from ~100s to under a second by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13236
* Delete dead AddLinksAtLevel by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13239
* test(replication): split async replication acceptance tests into two CI groups by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13234
* Summarize storage lookup timings in every slow-query log line by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13124
* perf(roaringsetrange): build compaction nodes into one reused buffer by @aliszka in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13154
* test(replication): reduce replica-slow acceptance test suite time by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13245
* test(acceptance): start the shared server only for suites that use it and reuse it for single-node tests by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13244
* Expose the batch-delete cap in the gRPC BatchDeleteReply by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13103
* Cap the filtered batch delete resolve at QUERY_MAXIMUM_RESULTS by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13104
* Resolve filter and batch-delete doc ids in parallel by @byronvoorbach in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13106
* refactor(test): start the shared acceptance server by default and skip it only for own-cluster suites by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13251
* async replication: drain on a reuse-safe latch instead of a shared WaitGroup by @jeroiraz in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13201
* debug: allow the debug vector rebuild on HFresh by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13257
* Answer 422 or 404 for an invalid class name instead of 500 or 403 by @dirkkul in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13260
* test(db): speed up the slowest integration tests by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13263
* test(acceptance): cut fast-group-3 test time by half by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13264
* fix(backup): poll participant status with exponential backoff during commit by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13266
* perf(refcache): index cacher jobs by identifier to avoid quadratic lookup by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13267
* fix(ci): reduce number of articles ingested in `TestGRPC_Batching` by @tsmith023 in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13259
* test(acceptance): cut fast-group-5 test time by over a third by @antas-marcin in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13268
* debug: allow the debug vector rebuild on geo indexes by @asdine in https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/pull/13261


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate/compare/v1.39.6...v1.39.7
